verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair question for a SaaS secrets platform like 1Password, so the axis applies. The pack shows no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The Events API only retrieves activity for forwarding to a SIEM, which is a pull model rather than webhook subscriptions, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
